name: ISO/IEC 27001
description: Annex A information security controls (organisational, people, physical, technological).

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.objective: Define, approve, publish and review information security policies.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.objective: Define and allocate security roles and responsibilities.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.objective: Separate conflicting duties and areas of responsibility.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.objective: Management requires personnel to apply security per policy.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.objective: Maintain contact with relevant authorities.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.objective: Maintain contact with security interest groups.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.objective: Collect and analyse information about security threats.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.objective: Integrate security into project management.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.objective: Maintain an inventory of assets and owners.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.objective: Define and enforce acceptable-use rules.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.objective: Personnel return organisational assets on change/termination.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.objective: Classify information by value and sensitivity.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.objective: Apply labelling procedures per the classification scheme.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.objective: Protect information during transfer by all methods.

controls.title: Access control
controls.objective: Establish and enforce access-control rules.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.objective: Manage the full life cycle of identities.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.objective: Control allocation and management of authentication information.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.objective: Provision, review and revoke access rights per policy.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.objective: Manage security risks from supplier products/services.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.objective: Include security requirements in supplier agreements.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.objective: Manage security risks across the ICT supply chain.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.objective: Monitor and review supplier service delivery.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.objective: Manage security for acquisition and use of cloud services.

controls.title: Incident management planning and preparation
controls.objective: Plan and prepare for security incident management.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.objective: Assess events and decide if they are incidents.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.objective: Respond to incidents per documented procedures.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.objective: Use incident lessons to strengthen controls.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.objective: Identify, collect and preserve evidence.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.objective: Maintain security during disruption.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.objective: Plan ICT continuity based on business objectives.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.objective: Identify and meet applicable requirements.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.objective: Protect intellectual property rights.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.objective: Protect records against loss, falsification and unauthorised access.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.objective: Protect privacy and personally identifiable information.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.objective: Independently review the security approach at intervals.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards
controls.objective: Regularly review compliance with the security policy set.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.objective: Document and make available operating procedures.

controls.title: Screening
controls.objective: Verify background of candidates before employment.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.objective: State security responsibilities in employment terms.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.objective: Provide ongoing security awareness and training.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.objective: Operate a disciplinary process for security violations.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.objective: Define security duties that persist after role change.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.objective: Use NDAs reflecting information protection needs.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.objective: Protect information accessed outside organisational premises.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.objective: Provide a mechanism to report security events.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.objective: Define perimeters to protect areas holding information.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.objective: Protect secure areas with appropriate entry controls.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.objective: Design and apply physical security for facilities.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.objective: Continuously monitor premises for unauthorised access.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.objective: Protect against physical and environmental threats.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.objective: Apply measures for working in secure areas.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.objective: Enforce clear-desk and clear-screen rules.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.objective: Site and protect equipment to reduce risk.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.objective: Protect off-site assets.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.objective: Manage storage media through its life cycle.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.objective: Protect equipment from utility failures.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.objective: Protect power and telecommunications cabling.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.objective: Maintain equipment to ensure availability and integrity.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.objective: Verify removal of data before disposal/re-use.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.objective: Protect information on user endpoint devices.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.objective: Restrict and manage privileged access rights.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.objective: Restrict access to information per access-control policy.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.objective: Manage access to source code and development tools.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.objective: Implement secure authentication technologies.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.objective: Monitor and tune resource use to meet capacity needs.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.objective: Protect against malware with user awareness and controls.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.objective: Identify and address technical vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.objective: Establish and maintain secure configurations.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.objective: Delete information when no longer required.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.objective: Mask data per policy and applicable requirements.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.objective: Apply measures to prevent data leakage.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.objective: Maintain and test backups per an agreed policy.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.objective: Provide redundancy to meet availability needs.

controls.title: Logging
controls.objective: Produce, store and review activity logs.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.objective: Monitor systems and networks for anomalous behaviour.

controls.title: Clock synchronisation
controls.objective: Synchronise clocks to an approved time source.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.objective: Restrict and control privileged utility programs.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.objective: Control software installation on operational systems.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.objective: Secure and manage networks and network devices.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.objective: Identify and manage security of network services.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.objective: Segregate groups of services and systems on networks.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.objective: Manage access to external websites.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.objective: Define and implement rules for cryptography and key management.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.objective: Apply security rules across the development life cycle.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.objective: Identify and approve application security requirements.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.objective: Apply secure engineering principles.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.objective: Apply secure coding principles.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.objective: Define and perform security testing.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.objective: Direct and monitor outsourced development.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.objective: Separate development, test and production.

controls.title: Change management
controls.objective: Subject changes to change-management procedures.

controls.title: Test information
controls.objective: Select, protect and manage test information.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.objective: Plan audit tests to minimise operational disruption.
